assessmentQuestionVersion.name: Food_RiskAssessment_Q7
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: Food safety plan developed and used/ lack of identification & control of Critical Control Points increases risk of process errors, contamination of food and/or survival/growth of pathogens
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: No plan or low level of use; does not include all PHFs/higher risk processes; or new facility-use of plan not yet assessed Moderate level of use of plan; covers all PHFs/higher risk processes High level of use for processes outlined in food safety plan; plan covers all PHFs & higher risk processes
